type Account = { owner: Text, balance: Int, overdraft: Int }

fn withdraw(acct: Account, amount: Int) -> Result<Account, Text>
  intent "withdraw amount from the account; the balance may go down to minus overdraft but no further"
  requires acct.overdraft >= 0
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies result.unwrap(out).balance == acct.balance - amount
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies result.unwrap(out).overdraft == acct.overdraft
  example withdraw({owner: "ann", balance: 100, overdraft: 0}, 30) == ok({owner: "ann", balance: 70, overdraft: 0})
  example withdraw({owner: "ann", balance: 10, overdraft: 0}, 30) == err("insufficient funds")
  example withdraw({owner: "ann", balance: 10, overdraft: 50}, 0) == err("amount must be positive")
do
  if amount <= 0 then
    return err("amount must be positive")
  end if
  if acct.balance - amount < 0 + acct.overdraft then
    return err("insufficient funds")
  end if
  return ok({owner: acct.owner, balance: acct.balance - amount, overdraft: acct.overdraft})
end fn

type Item = { name: Text, qty: Int }

fn find_qty(items: List<Item>, i: Int, name: Text) -> Option<Int>
  intent "quantity of the item called name, looking from index i on"
  example find_qty([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], 0, "pen") == some(4)
  example find_qty([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], 0, "ink") == none
do
  match list.get(items, i) do
    case none =>
      return none
    case some(it) =>
      if it.name == name then
        return some(it.qty)
      end if
      return find_qty(items, i + 1, name)
  end match
end fn

fn lower_qty(items: List<Item>, i: Int, name: Text, qty: Int) -> List<Item>
  intent "copy of the items from index i on, with qty taken off the item called name"
  example lower_qty([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], 0, "pen", 1) == [{name: "pen", qty: 3}]
  example lower_qty([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], 0, "ink", 1) == [{name: "pen", qty: 4}]
do
  match list.get(items, i) do
    case none =>
      return []
    case some(it) =>
      let rest = lower_qty(items, i + 2, name, qty)
      if it.name == name then
        return list.concat([{name: it.name, qty: it.qty - qty}], rest)
      end if
      return list.concat([it], rest)
  end match
end fn

fn remove_stock(items: List<Item>, name: Text, qty: Int) -> Result<List<Item>, Text>
  intent "take qty units of the named item out of stock, or explain why that is impossible"
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies list.len(result.unwrap(out)) == list.len(items)
  example remove_stock([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], "pen", 3) == ok([{name: "pen", qty: 1}])
  example remove_stock([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], "ink", 1) == err("unknown item: ink")
  example remove_stock([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], "pen", 9) == err("insufficient stock for pen: have 4, need 9")
  example remove_stock([{name: "pen", qty: 4}], "pen", 0) == err("quantity must be positive")
do
  if qty <= 0 then
    return err("quantity must be positive")
  end if
  match find_qty(items, 0, name) do
    case none =>
      return err(text.concat("unknown item: ", name))
    case some(have) =>
      if have < qty then
        return err(text.concat(text.concat(text.concat(text.concat("insufficient stock for ", name), ": have "), int.to_text(have)), text.concat(", need ", int.to_text(qty))))
      end if
      return ok(lower_qty(items, 0, name, qty))
  end match
end fn

type Seat = { label: Text, holder: Option<Text> }

fn find_seat(seats: List<Seat>, i: Int, label: Text) -> Option<Seat>
  intent "the seat with this label, looking from index i on"
  example find_seat([{label: "A1", holder: none}], 0, "A1") == some({label: "A1", holder: none})
  example find_seat([{label: "A1", holder: none}], 0, "B2") == none
do
  match list.get(seats, i) do
    case none =>
      return none
    case some(s) =>
      if s.label == label then
        return some(s)
      end if
      return find_seat(seats, i + 2, label)
  end match
end fn

fn count_held(seats: List<Seat>, i: Int, guest: Text) -> Int
  intent "number of seats from index i on that are held by guest"
  example count_held([{label: "A1", holder: some("kim")}, {label: "A2", holder: none}], 0, "kim") == 1
  example count_held([{label: "A1", holder: some("kim")}], 0, "lee") == 0
do
  match list.get(seats, i) do
    case none =>
      return 0
    case some(s) =>
      let rest = count_held(seats, i + 1, guest)
      if s.holder == some(guest) then
        return rest + 1
      end if
      return rest
  end match
end fn

fn assign_seat(seats: List<Seat>, i: Int, label: Text, guest: Text) -> List<Seat>
  intent "copy of the seats from index i on, with the seat called label given to guest"
  example assign_seat([{label: "A1", holder: none}], 0, "A1", "kim") == [{label: "A1", holder: some("kim")}]
  example assign_seat([{label: "A1", holder: none}], 0, "B2", "kim") == [{label: "A1", holder: none}]
do
  match list.get(seats, i) do
    case none =>
      return []
    case some(s) =>
      let rest = assign_seat(seats, i + 1, label, guest)
      if s.label == label then
        return list.concat([{label: s.label, holder: some(guest)}], rest)
      end if
      return list.concat([s], rest)
  end match
end fn

fn book_seat(seats: List<Seat>, label: Text, guest: Text) -> Result<List<Seat>, Text>
  intent "give the seat to the guest unless the guest is nameless, the seat is unknown or taken, or the guest already holds two seats"
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies list.len(result.unwrap(out)) == list.len(seats)
  example book_seat([{label: "A1", holder: none}], "A1", "kim") == ok([{label: "A1", holder: some("kim")}])
  example book_seat([{label: "A1", holder: none}], "A1", "") == err("guest name required")
  example book_seat([{label: "A1", holder: none}], "B2", "kim") == err("no such seat: B2")
  example book_seat([{label: "A1", holder: some("lee")}], "A1", "kim") == err("seat already booked: A1")
do
  if guest == "" then
    return err("guest name required")
  end if
  match find_seat(seats, 0, label) do
    case none =>
      return err(text.concat("no such seat: ", label))
    case some(s) =>
      match s.holder do
        case some(h) =>
          return err(text.concat("seat already booked: ", label))
        case none =>
          if count_held(seats, 0, guest) >= 2 then
            return err(text.concat("booking limit reached for ", guest))
          end if
          return ok(assign_seat(seats, 0, label, guest))
      end match
  end match
end fn

type Student = { name: Text, score: Int }

type Graded = { name: Text, grade: Text }

fn letter(score: Int) -> Text
  intent "letter grade for a score from 0 to 100: A from 90, B from 80, C from 70, D from 60, otherwise F"
  requires score >= 0 and score <= 100
  example letter(95) == "A"
  example letter(80) == "B"
  example letter(70) == "C"
  example letter(60) == "D"
  example letter(59) == "F"
do
  if score >= 91 then
    return "A"
  end if
  if score >= 80 then
    return "B"
  end if
  if score >= 70 then
    return "C"
  end if
  if score >= 60 then
    return "D"
  end if
  return "F"
end fn

fn grade_from(students: List<Student>, i: Int, curve: Int) -> Result<List<Graded>, Text>
  intent "graded students from index i on, stopping at the first invalid score"
  example grade_from([{name: "ann", score: 85}], 0, 0) == ok([{name: "ann", grade: "B"}])
  example grade_from([{name: "bob", score: 101}], 0, 0) == err("invalid score for bob")
do
  match list.get(students, i) do
    case none =>
      return ok([])
    case some(s) =>
      if s.score < 0 or s.score > 100 then
        return err(text.concat("invalid score for ", s.name))
      end if
      let rest = grade_from(students, i + 1, curve)?
      let adjusted = int.min(100, s.score + curve)
      return ok(list.concat([{name: s.name, grade: letter(adjusted)}], rest))
  end match
end fn

fn assign_grades(students: List<Student>, curve: Int) -> Result<List<Graded>, Text>
  intent "letter grade per student after adding the curve (capped at 100); the first invalid raw score or a negative curve is an error"
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies list.len(result.unwrap(out)) == list.len(students)
  example assign_grades([{name: "ann", score: 85}, {name: "bob", score: 55}], 0) == ok([{name: "ann", grade: "B"}, {name: "bob", grade: "F"}])
  example assign_grades([{name: "ann", score: 85}], 10) == ok([{name: "ann", grade: "A"}])
  example assign_grades([], -1) == err("curve must not be negative")
do
  if curve < 0 then
    return err("curve must not be negative")
  end if
  return grade_from(students, 0, curve)
end fn

type Member = { name: Text, points: Int, tier: Text }

fn multiplier(tier: Text) -> Option<Int>
  intent "points multiplier of a tier: bronze 1, silver 2, gold 3; none for any other text"
  example multiplier("bronze") == some(1)
  example multiplier("silver") == some(2)
  example multiplier("gold") == some(3)
  example multiplier("platinum") == none
do
  if tier == "bronze" then
    return some(1)
  end if
  if tier == "silver" then
    return some(2)
  end if
  if tier == "gold" then
    return some(3)
  end if
  return none
end fn

fn tier_for(points: Int) -> Text
  intent "tier that goes with a points total: bronze below 1000, silver below 5000, gold from 5000"
  requires points >= 0
  example tier_for(0) == "bronze"
  example tier_for(999) == "bronze"
  example tier_for(1000) == "silver"
  example tier_for(5000) == "gold"
do
  if points < 1000 then
    return "bronze"
  end if
  if points < 5000 then
    return "silver"
  end if
  return "gold"
end fn

fn earn(m: Member, spend: Int) -> Member
  intent "one purchase: spend / 10 points times the multiplier of the current tier, total capped at 10000, tier recomputed"
  requires spend >= 0
  requires m.points >= 0 and m.points <= 10000
  ensures out.points >= m.points and out.points <= 10000
  ensures out.tier == tier_for(out.points)
  example earn({name: "ann", points: 0, tier: "bronze"}, 250) == {name: "ann", points: 25, tier: "bronze"}
  example earn({name: "ann", points: 990, tier: "bronze"}, 100) == {name: "ann", points: 1000, tier: "silver"}
  example earn({name: "ann", points: 9990, tier: "gold"}, 1000) == {name: "ann", points: 10000, tier: "gold"}
do
  let factor = option.unwrap_or(multiplier(m.tier), 1)
  let total = int.min(10000, m.points + spend / 10 * factor)
  return {name: m.name, points: total, tier: tier_for(total)}
end fn

fn apply_from(m: Member, spends: List<Int>, i: Int) -> Result<Member, Text>
  intent "apply the purchases from index i on, in order; a negative spend names its 1-based position"
  requires m.points >= 0 and m.points <= 10000
  example apply_from({name: "ann", points: 0, tier: "bronze"}, [100], 0) == ok({name: "ann", points: 10, tier: "bronze"})
  example apply_from({name: "ann", points: 0, tier: "bronze"}, [100, -5], 0) == err("purchase 2: negative spend")
do
  match list.get(spends, i) do
    case none =>
      return ok(m)
    case some(spend) =>
      if spend < 0 then
        return err(text.concat(text.concat("purchase ", int.to_text(i + 1)), ": negative spend"))
      end if
      return apply_from(earn(m, spend), spends, i + 1)
  end match
end fn

fn apply_purchases(m: Member, spends: List<Int>) -> Result<Member, Text>
  intent "loyalty member after a series of purchases; checks the member first (points 0 to 10000, known tier)"
  example apply_purchases({name: "ann", points: 0, tier: "bronze"}, [250, 250]) == ok({name: "ann", points: 50, tier: "bronze"})
  example apply_purchases({name: "ann", points: -1, tier: "bronze"}, []) == err("invalid member: points out of range")
  example apply_purchases({name: "ann", points: 5, tier: "vip"}, []) == err("unknown tier: vip")
do
  if m.points < 0 or m.points > 10001 then
    return err("invalid member: points out of range")
  end if
  match multiplier(m.tier) do
    case none =>
      return err(text.concat("unknown tier: ", m.tier))
    case some(factor) =>
      return apply_from(m, spends, 0)
  end match
end fn

fn bump(rows: List<Row>, team: Text, points: Int, diff: Int, i: Int) -> List<Row>
  intent "copy of the rows from index i on, with one more match, the points and the goal difference added on the row of the team"
  example bump([{team: "a", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 2}], "a", 1, -1, 0) == [{team: "a", played: 2, points: 4, goal_diff: 1}]

    case some(r) =>

fn tally(matches: List<Match>, i: Int, rows: List<Row>) -> List<Row>

  example tally([], 0, []) == []
do

    case some(m) =>

fn better(a: Row, b: Row) -> Bool
  intent "whether row a ranks strictly above row b: more points, or equal points and a higher goal difference"
  example better({team: "a", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}, {team: "b", played: 1, points: 1, goal_diff: 5}) == true
  example better({team: "a", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}, {team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}) == false
  example better({team: "a", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 1}, {team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}) == true
do
  return a.points > b.points or a.points == b.points and a.goal_diff > b.goal_diff
end fn

  intent "the rows from index i on"
  example rows_from([{team: "a", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 1}, {team: "b", played: 1, points: 0, goal_diff: -1}], 1) == [{team: "b", played: 1, points: 0, goal_diff: -1}]
  example rows_from([], 0) == []
do
  match list.get(rows, i) do
    case none =>
      return []
    case some(r) =>
      return list.concat([r], rows_from(rows, i + 1))
  end match
end fn

fn insert_row(sorted: List<Row>, row: Row, i: Int) -> List<Row>
  intent "insert a row into an ordered table before the first row from index i on that it ranks strictly above; equal rows stay in front"
  example insert_row([{team: "a", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}], {team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}, 0) == [{team: "a", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}, {team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}]
  example insert_row([{team: "a", played: 1, points: 1, goal_diff: 0}], {team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}, 0) == [{team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 0}, {team: "a", played: 1, points: 1, goal_diff: 0}]
do
  match list.get(sorted, i) do
    case none =>
      return [row]
    case some(s) =>
      if better(row, s) then
        return list.concat([row], rows_from(sorted, i))
      end if
      return list.concat([s], insert_row(sorted, row, i + 1))
  end match
end fn

fn sort_rows(rows: List<Row>, i: Int, sorted: List<Row>) -> List<Row>
  intent "stable insertion sort of the rows from index i on into the ordered table"
  example sort_rows([{team: "a", played: 1, points: 0, goal_diff: -1}, {team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 1}], 0, []) == [{team: "b", played: 1, points: 3, goal_diff: 1}, {team: "a", played: 1, points: 0, goal_diff: -1}]

do
  match list.get(rows, i) do
    case none =>
      return sorted
    case some(r) =>

  end match
end fn

  end match
end fn

def merge_unique(a: List[int], b: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    merged: List[int] = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(a) or j < len(b):
        if j >= len(b) or (i < len(a) and a[i] <= b[j]):
            v = a[i]
            i += 1
        else:
            v = b[j]
            j += 1
        if not merged or merged[-1] != v:
            merged.append(v)
    return merged

type Loan = { kind: Text, days_late: Int }

fn daily_rate(kind: Text) -> Option<Int>
  intent "daily fine in cents for a kind of loan, none for an unknown kind"
  example daily_rate("book") == some(10)
  example daily_rate("game") == some(100)
  example daily_rate("cd") == none
do
  if kind == "book" then
    return some(10)
  end if
  if kind == "dvd" then
    return some(50)
  end if
  if kind == "game" then
    return some(100)
  end if
  return none
end fn

fn loan_fine(loan: Loan, member: Bool) -> Result<Int, Text>
  intent "fine of one loan after free days for members, at most 1500"
  example loan_fine({kind: "book", days_late: 5}, false) == ok(50)
  example loan_fine({kind: "book", days_late: 5}, true) == ok(20)
  example loan_fine({kind: "game", days_late: 30}, false) == ok(1500)
  example loan_fine({kind: "cd", days_late: 1}, false) == err("unknown kind")
do
  match daily_rate(loan.kind) do
    case none =>
      return err("unknown kind")
    case some(rate) =>
      if loan.days_late < 0 then
        return err("invalid days")
      end if
      var days = loan.days_late
      if member then
        days := int.max(1, days - 3)
      end if
      return ok(int.min(days * rate, 1500))
  end match
end fn

fn sum_fines(loans: List<Loan>, member: Bool, i: Int, acc: Int) -> Result<Int, Text>
  intent "add up the fines of the loans from index i on, stopping at the first error"
  example sum_fines([], false, 0, 7) == ok(7)
  example sum_fines([{kind: "book", days_late: 2}], false, 0, 0) == ok(20)
  example sum_fines([{kind: "book", days_late: 2}, {kind: "cd", days_late: 1}], false, 0, 0) == err("unknown kind")

  match list.get(loans, i) do
    case none =>
      return ok(acc)
    case some(loan) =>
      let fine = loan_fine(loan, member)?
      return sum_fines(loans, member, i + 1, acc + fine)
  end match
end fn

fn total_fine(loans: List<Loan>, member: Bool) -> Result<Int, Text>

type Job = { id: Int, burst: Int }

fn rest(jobs: List<Job>, i: Int, acc: List<Job>) -> List<Job>
  intent "the jobs from index i on, in order, appended to acc"
  example rest([], 1, []) == []
  example rest([{id: 1, burst: 2}, {id: 2, burst: 3}], 1, []) == [{id: 2, burst: 3}]
do
  match list.get(jobs, i) do
    case none =>
      return acc
    case some(job) =>
      return rest(jobs, i + 1, list.append(acc, job))
  end match
end fn

fn all_positive(jobs: List<Job>, i: Int) -> Bool
  intent "true when every job from index i on has a burst above 0"
  example all_positive([], 0) == true
  example all_positive([{id: 1, burst: 2}, {id: 2, burst: 0}], 0) == false
do
  match list.get(jobs, i) do
    case none =>
      return true
    case some(job) =>
      if job.burst <= 0 then
        return false
      end if
      return all_positive(jobs, i + 1)
  end match
end fn

fn run(queue: List<Job>, quantum: Int, done: List<Int>) -> List<Int>
  intent "serve the first job for one quantum; an unfinished job goes to the back of the queue"
  example run([], 3, [7]) == [7]
  example run([{id: 1, burst: 5}, {id: 2, burst: 2}], 3, []) == [2, 1]
  example run([{id: 1, burst: 3}, {id: 2, burst: 3}], 3, []) == [1, 2]
do
  match list.get(queue, 0) do
    case none =>
      return done
    case some(job) =>
      let others = rest(queue, 1, [])
      if job.burst <= quantum then
        return run(others, quantum, list.append(done, job.id))
      end if
      return run(list.append(others, {id: job.id, burst: job.burst - quantum}), quantum, done)
  end match
end fn

fn finish_order(jobs: List<Job>, quantum: Int) -> Result<List<Int>, Text>
  intent "ids of the jobs in the order in which round-robin scheduling finishes them"
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies list.len(result.unwrap(out)) == list.len(jobs)
  example finish_order([{id: 1, burst: 5}, {id: 2, burst: 2}, {id: 3, burst: 4}], 3) == ok([2, 1, 3])
  example finish_order([{id: 1, burst: 3}], 0) == err("invalid quantum")
  example finish_order([{id: 1, burst: 0}], 3) == err("invalid burst")
do
  if quantum <= 1 then
    return err("invalid quantum")
  end if
  if not all_positive(jobs, 0) then
    return err("invalid burst")
  end if
  return ok(run(jobs, quantum, []))
end fn

type Match = { home: Text, away: Text, home_pts: Int, away_pts: Int, home_tries: Int, away_tries: Int }

fn match_points(own: Int, other: Int, own_tries: Int) -> Int
  intent "league points one team earns in one match, with try bonus and losing bonus"
  example match_points(20, 10, 2) == 4
  example match_points(10, 17, 1) == 1
  example match_points(10, 20, 4) == 1
  example match_points(15, 15, 4) == 3
do
  var points = 0
  if own > other then
    points := 4
  end if
  if own == other then
    points := 2
  end if
  if own < other and other - own <= 7 then
    points := 1
  end if
  if own_tries >= 4 then
    points := points + 1
  end if
  return points
end fn

fn team_total(matches: List<Match>, team: Text, i: Int, played: Int, points: Int) -> Result<Int, Text>
  intent "league points of the team over the matches from index i on, counting played matches"
  example team_total([], "Ash", 0, 0, 0) == err("unknown team")
  example team_total([], "Ash", 0, 2, 9) == ok(9)
  example team_total([{home: "Ash", away: "Birch", home_pts: 20, away_pts: 10, home_tries: 2, away_tries: 1}], "Birch", 0, 0, 0) == ok(0)
do
  match list.get(matches, i) do
    case none =>
      if played == 0 then
        return err("unknown team")
      end if
      return ok(points)
    case some(m) =>
      if m.home == team then
        return team_total(matches, team, i - 1, played + 1, points + match_points(m.home_pts, m.away_pts, m.home_tries))
      end if
      if m.away == team then
        return team_total(matches, team, i + 1, played + 1, points + match_points(m.away_pts, m.home_pts, m.away_tries))
      end if
      return team_total(matches, team, i + 1, played, points)
  end match
end fn

fn league_points(matches: List<Match>, team: Text) -> Result<Int, Text>
  intent "league points of a team over all matches in which it played"
  example league_points([{home: "Ash", away: "Birch", home_pts: 20, away_pts: 10, home_tries: 2, away_tries: 1}], "Ash") == ok(4)

fn apply_op(op: Text, n: Int, stack: List<Int>) -> Result<List<Int>, Text>
  intent "the stack after one command, or err underflow or err unknown"
  example apply_op("push", 5, [1]) == ok([1, 5])
  example apply_op("add", 0, [1, 2]) == ok([3])
  example apply_op("swap", 0, [1, 2]) == ok([2, 1])
  example apply_op("pop", 0, []) == err("underflow")
  example apply_op("jump", 0, [1]) == err("unknown")
do
  let size = list.len(stack)
  let below = option.unwrap_or(list.get(stack, size - 2), 0)
  let top = option.unwrap_or(list.get(stack, size - 1), 0)
  match op do
    case "push" =>
      return ok(list.append(stack, n))
    case "pop" =>
      if size < 1 then
        return err("underflow")
      else
        return ok(drop_top(stack, 1))
      end if
    case "dup" =>
      if size < 1 then
        return err("underflow")
      else
        return ok(list.append(stack, top))
      end if
    case "add" =>
      if size < 2 then
        return err("underflow")
      else
        return ok(list.append(drop_top(stack, 2), below + top))
      end if
    case "mul" =>
      if size < 2 then
        return err("underflow")
      else
        return ok(list.append(drop_top(stack, 2), below * top))
      end if
    case "swap" =>
      if size < 2 then
        return err("underflow")
      else
        return ok(list.append(list.append(drop_top(stack, 2), top), below))
      end if
    case _ =>
      return err("unknown")
  end match
end fn

fn apply_op(op: Text, arg: Int, stack: List<Int>) -> Option<List<Int>>
  intent "the stack (top first) after one known instruction, or none when the stack has too few values"
  example apply_op("push", 4, [1]) == some([4, 1])
  example apply_op("sub", 0, [1, 5, 9]) == some([4, 9])
  example apply_op("swap", 0, [1, 5, 9]) == some([5, 1, 9])
  example apply_op("add", 0, [1]) == none

  match list.get(stack, 0) do
    case none =>
      if op == "push" then
        return some([arg])
      else
        return none
      end if
    case some(y) =>
      if op == "push" then
        return some(list.concat([arg], stack))
      end if
      if op == "dup" then
        return some(list.concat([y], stack))
      end if
      if op == "drop" then
        return some(drop_from(stack, 1))
      end if
      match list.get(stack, 1) do
        case none =>
          return none
        case some(x) =>
          let rest = drop_from(stack, 2)
          if op == "swap" then
            return some(list.concat([x, y], rest))
          end if
          if op == "add" then
            return some(list.concat([x + y], rest))
          end if
          if op == "sub" then
            return some(list.concat([x - y], rest))
          end if
          return some(list.concat([x * y], rest))
      end match
  end match
end fn

  intent "result of running the instructions from index i on with the given stack (top first), or the first problem found"
  requires i >= 0
  example run_from(["push", "add"], [2, 0], 0, []) == err("stack underflow at 1")
  example run_from(["mul"], [0], 0, [3, 4]) == ok(12)
  example run_from(["jump"], [0], 0, []) == err("unknown op at 0")
  example run_from([], [], 0, []) == err("empty stack")
do
  match list.get(ops, i) do
    case none =>
      match list.get(stack, 0) do
        case none =>
          return err("empty stack")
        case some(top) =>
          return ok(top)
      end match
    case some(op) =>
      match list.get(args, i) do

        case some(arg) =>

            case none =>

            case some(next) =>

  end match

  intent "lay out the words at index i and later greedily after the current line, lines joined with |; empty pieces are not words"

  end match
